name: Gray Thornbill
rangeDescription: Arfak mountains to southeastern ranges of new guinea
description: A tiny bird of montane forest canopy. Medium gray above and clean white below with a black bill and dark eye.

name: Tawny-breasted Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Oak-rhododendron forest of northeastern india (assam and manipur)
description: A small, rust-coloured bird with gray cheeks and white on the throat and belly. The upperparts are brown, and the rusty underparts lack the white streaks of other similar species.

name: Greater Melampitta
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed lower montane slopes of new guinea
description: A large, rare, ground bird from scattered areas of foothill and lower montane limestone forest. All black plumage with long legs, strong bill, long tail and some bare facial behind the eye.

name: Red-bellied Myzomela
rangeDescription: Malaita (central solomon islands)
description: A bulky, striking myzomela, mostly pitch black with a bright red rump and a bright crimson chest, throat, and flanks forming a “vest.” Belly, back, and head deep black. Female chocolate-brown above and ruddy-brown below.

name: Ceara Woodcreeper
rangeDescription: Northeastern brazil (ceará and paraíba to alagoas)
description: Small, slim woodcreeper with a thin slightly decurved bill. Found in humid forests, where it regularly follows mixed-species flocks.

name: Sierra Leone Prinia
rangeDescription: Montane ravines of eastern sierra leone, southern guinea, and southwestern ivory coast
description: A mostly dark gray long-tailed warbler with a striking whitish eye, buff flanks, and pinkish legs. Local and scarce in a handful of hills and mountains in Upper Guinea, where pairs and small groups skulk low down in very wet forest edge, riverine scrub, and thickets in gullies between 600 and 1600 meters of elevation.

name: Santa Marta Antbird
rangeDescription: Northern colombia (sierra nevada de santa marta)
description: Slender, long-tailed antbird restricted to the lower slopes of Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. It is heavily streaked on the head, breast, and back and has a tawny belly and rump.

name: Red-headed Vulture
rangeDescription: India and southeastern asia
description: A dark, medium-sized vulture with a bare reddish head and loose flaps on the side of the neck. Juvenile is browner with scruffy, pale feathers on the head.

name: Plain Nightjar
rangeDescription: Thornscrub of sub-saharan africa and southwestern arabian peninsula
description: A medium-sized, unusually plain nightjar. Overall coloration varies from rufous to brown to gray.

name: Black-crested Warbler
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to northern venezuela, ecuador, and northern peru
description: Small yellow warbler found in the understory of Andean forest and scrub from around 2,500-3,500m. Olive above and brighter yellow below, with bright yellow eyebrow and black crown.

name: Letter-winged Kite
rangeDescription: Interior of australia; disperses irregularly to coasts
description: Small, striking gray and white raptor with black shoulder patches. Underparts white with two black patches on underwing extending from

name: Flores Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Flores (western lesser sundas)
description: Small and stout forest-dweller that hops and buzzes about in the canopy like a large, active insect. Note male’s iridescent dark blue back, bright red chest, and black line extending down the white belly.

name: Cozumel Emerald
rangeDescription: Cozumel (off yucatán peninsula, southeastern mexico); one old specimen isla mujeres
description: Only on Cozumel Island, Mexico, where it is usually the most frequently encountered hummingbird. Feeds low to high on a variety of flowers, preferring forest edge, gardens, and other semi-open habitats.

name: Marquesan Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Marquesas islands (hatutaa and fatu huku)
description: A rotund, short-legged ground-dwelling dove that usually runs rather than flies when startled. Slate-gray belly contrasts with paler gray chest and head, and with purplish shoulders and back.

name: Brown Violetear
rangeDescription: Belize and guatemala to the guianas, brazil, and bolivia
description: Uncommon, rather large but drab, fairly short-billed hummingbird of tropical and subtropical forest and edge. Can be aggressive when defending flower patches from most other hummingbirds.

name: Green-headed Tanager
rangeDescription: Southeastern paraguay to southeastern brazil and northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Strikingly beautiful multicolored tanager found in the canopy of humid forests, at forest borders, and in second growth, urban parks, and gardens. The head, nape, chin, and breast are a bright aquamarine-green with a lime green neck patch, wings, belly and an orange rump.

name: Chestnut Quail-thrush
rangeDescription: Southeastern south australia, adjacent northwestern victoria and southwestern new south wales
description: Heavily patterned terrestrial bird of eastern South Australia, northwestern Victoria, and western New South Wales. White eyebrow and moustache, with a deep chestnut-brown back and intricately patterned wing.

name: Ashy-breasted Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (luzon and negros)
description: A little-known small drab bird of lowland and foothill forest. Gray-brown above, darker in the wing, with a gray-brown chest blending to a white belly and a small white throat patch.

name: Atlas Wheatear
rangeDescription: Morocco to northeastern algeria; winters to mauritania
description: Small thrush-like bird with distinctive black-and-white tail pattern that is striking in flight. Breeding male has a black face, throat and wing, gray back and crown, and white underparts.

name: Southern Screamer
rangeDescription: Wet lowlands of southeastern peru to northern argentina and southern brazil
description: Huge and odd-looking gray gooselike species with long red legs. Note the wispy crest on the back of the head, the bare red face, and a broad dark collar with a thin white collar above it.
